import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    n = int(input_data[0])
    s = input_data[1]
    
    count = 0
    # Iterate through each character in the string
    # If the character at index i is an even digit, then any substring ending at i
    # (starting from index 0 to i) will be even.
    # There are i + 1 such substrings.
    for i in range(n):
        digit = int(s[i])
        if digit % 2 == 0:
            count += (i + 1)
            
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
